import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. The placeholders {title} and {body} # will be replaced with the sanitized user input. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- post_title : str The headline or title of the blog post. post_body : str The full text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML for the blog post. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(post_title, str): raise TypeError("post_title must be a string") if not isinstance(post_body, str): raise TypeError("post_body must be a string") # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Insert the escaped values into the template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
